'''Gibber''' is a [[Rock]] type [[Guardian]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves into [[Turtuff]] at 6 bronze stars.

==Overview==
Current Description: "Lacking the ability to live in the sea, Gibber enjoys flailing on land, mimicking the way sea turtles swim."

Gibber is a purple rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A small, yellowish-tan turtle with a rocky, brown shell and a white underbelly/chin. Its eyes are black with brown highlights.

Gibber's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces tan with orange, white with light yellow, and brown becomes turquoise green.

== Evolution Trial ==
Gibber's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 6 bronze stars/19 copies. To evolve it into [[Turtuff]] you need to complete the following task:

* Obtain Shield x5 via [[Pinball]]. Protect our home!

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "Gibber and [[Droppit]] had a race. The Gibber rolled into a ball and, sure enough, won with ease."
